latHint: Think what you click on a computer.
pivHint: Paul says God's Spirit does not make us TIMID. We call someone very shy and easily frightened as TIMID as a ______.
winText: You found it. TIMID isn't just what God's Spirit doesn't make us. A very shy person is described as TIMID as a MOUSE.
lossText: The word was MOUSE. TIMID was the pivot. We say someone very shy and easily frightened is as TIMID as a MOUSE.
votdVerse: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
passageText: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands. For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline. So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner. Rather, join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God.
